subject: damage dealt
fact: Sixteen damage was dealt and the grapple secured.

subject: saving throw attempted
fact: A DC-14 Wisdom saving throw was rolled and failed.
source_quote: Roll a DC-14 Wisdom saving throw. Well. That didn't work.

subject: critical strike landed
fact: Two consecutive critical strikes were delivered.

subject: distance traveled
fact: Forty feet of vertical distance was covered before the drop.
source_quote: Forty feet. The stone floor dropped away beneath us.

subject: damage mitigated
fact: Twelve points of bludgeoning damage were deflected from the heart fungus's attack.
source_quote: I deflected twelve of the bludgeoning. The rest I accepted.

subject: damage dealt
fact: The heart fungus was destroyed in one round by radiant damage.
source_quote: I struck. And then struck again. The heart fungus wilted. One round. That was all it got.

subject: damage dealt
fact: Twenty-six points of damage were dealt to Glabbagool by Insect Plague.
source_quote: Twenty-six points of damage. The grey ooze took twenty-six points of damage from a spell he had nothing to do with.

subject: attack opportunity declined
fact: An opportunity attack was not taken when Jorlan charged Ilvara.
source_quote: Eight on the die. Eight says I do the sensible thing. ... I stepped aside and let Jorlan pass.

subject: spell availability noted
fact: A Revivify spell was offered to potentially restore a fallen minion.
source_quote: If anybody is too saddened by the loss of any of our minions, I do have a Revivify spell that I could use to bring one of them back.

subject: reach distance
fact: Fifteen feet of reach was noted as a generous distance when the target is on the floor.
source_quote: fifteen feet of reach is a very generous number when the thing reaching lives on the floor and I have been hovering at the ceiling being useless.

subject: weapon property
fact: Dawnbringer is not resistant to radiant damage and is eager to strike.
source_quote: It actually is doubly not resistant to radiant damage. Dawnbringer was already in my hand. She's not the sort of sword that waits politely in a scabbard...

subject: minion count
fact: Thirteen fungal minions were destroyed by Insect Plague.
source_quote: a biblical chittering that shredded the fungal minions instantly, all thirteen hit points of them, gone...

subject: terrain feature
fact: The cavern contained difficult terrain between the party and the heart fungus.
source_quote: massive, pulsing, ringed with spore-choked air and difficult terrain between me and it

subject: condition applied
fact: The frightened condition was applied, preventing approach to Ilvara.
source_quote: The frightened condition is not subtle — it is not a suggestion.

subject: damage taken
fact: Poison damage from the heart fungus was noted and filed away.
source_quote: The poison damage I noted and filed away beside the indignity.

subject: elevation
fact: The party operated from an elevated walkway above the cavern floor.
source_quote: I descended from the elevated walkway

subject: spell effect
fact: Insect Plague created a swarm that destroyed minions and affected terrain.
source_quote: Ilvara cast Insect Plague. The swarm hit the cavern entrance like a wall of sound and motion...

subject: damage dealt
fact: The heart fungus was reduced to zero hit points in one round.
source_quote: The heart fungus wilted. One round. That was all it got.

subject: reaction triggered
fact: Jorlan charged Ilvara with emotional intensity, overriding tactical positioning.
source_quote: the name that came out of him was not a battle cry. 'ILVARA' It came out like a wound reopening.
